name: omapod
author: Dorneles
description: omapod - NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) viewer for Omarchy status bar.

barWidget.description: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day with detailed popup viewer, date navigation, inline video player, 1-click wallpaper, and image copy.

schema.label: Bar Display Format
schema.description: Rocket icon only or rocket icon with picture title.

schema.label: Icon Style
schema.description: Bar icon style ( Classic Rocket, 󰛓 Rocket Launch, 󰭎 Telescope, 󰻌 Planet, 󰓏 Star).

schema.label: NASA API Key
schema.description: NASA API Key (default DEMO_KEY, or get one at api.nasa.gov).
